name: New OSHA Inspections and Citations by State
pitch: Businesses OSHA opened an inspection on or cited this month in your state, for independent safety consultants who help employers answer citations and build safety programs

provenAbroad.what: Same model sold in other US states: Citation Atlas sells weekly OSHA citation and inspection alerts at $29 a month per state or $79 for all states, and says other OSHA lead services start at $49

buyer.countNote: IBISWorld: 51,691 Occupational Health and Workplace Safety Services businesses in 2025; includes firms that are not consultants
buyer.reach: Consulting firms publish a business inbox on their own websites; ASSP runs a consultants practice specialty inside its 35,000-member society

price.reason: Matches Citation Atlas per state; below the $49 floor it reports for other OSHA lead services

competitors.name: Citation Atlas, all states plus API

data.publisher: US Department of Labor, OSHA (DOL Open Data Portal API v4)
data.subject: an establishment (employer worksite) OSHA inspected, with inspection type, NAICS, violation counts and penalties
data.countQuery: https://apiprod.dol.gov/v4/get/OSHA/inspection/json?limit=10000&filter_object={"field":"open_date","operator":"gt","value":"2026-09-01"} (needs a free DOL API key; no count endpoint, count the rows)
data.recordsNote: Not counted: the API needs a registered key (key sharing is banned) and osha.gov search pages refused the fetch. The DOL dataset list shows 'Daily' but last updated 2026-06-03, and the OSHA establishment search page said data through 05/07/2026; a reseller says it saw inspections opened Sep 17, 2026 as of Oct 16. Freshness must be probed before anything else.
data.privacy: Establishments are employers, but some are sole proprietors named after a person; keep only entity-suffixed names. Never include inspection narratives about injured workers or fatality details.

license.note: DOL says materials created by the federal government are generally public domain and may be used, reproduced and distributed without permission, but not in a way that implies DOL affiliation or endorsement. The API guide (updated Aug 5, 2024) requires a registered key and bans sharing it.

risks: Todd must register a DOL API key (an account step). Citations post about a month after issuance, so the list is slower than the name suggests. Incumbent already at $29.
